prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada in the year that the 1965 winner of the Best New Artist Grammy Award made their first appearance on US television?
answer:
The **Prime Minister of Canada was Lester B. Pearson**.

The 1965 Grammy for Best New Artist went to **The Beatles**, whose first U.S. television appearance was in **1964**, when Pearson was prime minister.
